string.text: Yo $fname, $c1_fname's here.
Well, hello.
As they say, “No matter how long the rope is, it will end eventually,” right?
Maybe you’ll finally answer me, huh?
$fname you little bitch...
Hey
$fname, i knew it!
Well, weren’t you expecting me?
Hey, “brother,” what kind of crap is this?
Ah, there you are.
So, how are things?
$c1_fname here.
You took some of the diet sausages I was saving, didn't you?
I heard you swiped an “unclaimed” flask from a table in the yard the day before yesterday. There was more than just vodka in it... That flask once saved my life, and you...
When are you paying back the three grand? I understand, but damn, that was two weeks ago! Now I can’t even eat properly—I have to roast meat over a campfire.

I heard you saw someone swipe my container yesterday, but had a hard time telling me about it, right? Why do I have to hear this sort of thing from other people?! And before that, you drank all my mineral water, too!
Someone let me know you swiped my pack of ammo from the concrete slab yesterday. That was mine! Damn, you can’t even make a quick run to the toilet without everything getting stolen!
Where’s the artifact? Only you and I knew about it, brother. They’ll take our heads for being late on the order! Anyway, it needs to be in the stash by tomorrow evening.
Did you swipe my dosimeter? I’m heading into the contaminated zone tomorrow. Give it back—I really need it.
I don’t get it, “buddy”—where’s the roll of fireproofing? If I remember right, you only wanted to cut off a couple of sheets. Then you took the whole roll! I want it back.
Give back the Kevlar plates before I cut you to pieces. I didn’t haggle for them for nothing.
You’re lucky I understand perfectly well that you can’t go without psi-blockers, but what the hell do you need half a pack for?!

You were the last one out of the common room yesterday. Guess what I couldn’t find in there? Anyway, give me back a pack of capacitors tomorrow morning—I urgently need to fix my PDA. And this isn’t the first time...
Where are all the energy drinks from my backpack?! I know it was you, you scumbag!
I know you swiped my thread yesterday. I can’t sew a backpack without it, so if you don’t return it, you’re going on the raid alone, got it? Smart guy...
You left and didn't say a word. It would have been fine, except you took 3 bottles of Vodka from me last night!

I know you stole my dry rations while drunk yesterday—the guys saw you with them. You took them, fine, but you could at least admit it. Or aren’t you a man anymore? By the way, I paid for them from our shared funds.
You knew I was saving up for some better grub. And what did I get? Canned food and a couple of fireflies! Couldn’t you have just asked like a normal person?

I left a plate of goulash for a couple minutes, damn it, and you went and wolfed it down. Like it? Couldn’t you ask? I would’ve shared. But no, you had to stuff it all into your own face... Proud, aren’t you...
Man, I understand you had to go on watch and that you’re broke. But why take the whole box of ammo? You made the expedition fall through.
Tell me, why do you need a “Dvoyka” when only a full service will save your gun? Are you a kleptomaniac? Now I don’t know what to clean my gun with. “Thanks”!
Give my flashlight back—the mosquitoes are driving me crazy. You don’t even need it; you haven’t gone on a trip in a week. And you’re acting like nothing happened...
Next time your ass shows up here, you better have something good for me.
Ah, I wish I could give you a little beating for your own good... My hands are itching already!
Stop acting like a lord, got it?
Better get me something in return. Keep that in mind next time you plan on showing your ugly face around here.
Don't think I’ll let this one pass.
I’ve had enough of your bullshit man! Come on!
Some fucking friend you are.
You know what? You’d better quit that as soon as possible.
You know what happens to the one who takes the initiative?
What the hell has gotten into you?
Well, we’ve really come to this... Even our own people are stealing everything now!
The $trader wants to see you by the way, so make sure to check what he wants.
You’ve really gotten yourself into a mess. $trader is looking for you, and he’s furious. How’s that karma?
Looks like you’ll have enough problems without me, since $leader wants to see you. I warned you.
When you head back to camp, remember that $trader wanted to see you about the job he gave you.
Why am I even wasting my time talking to you? $leader is waiting for you. Go see him.
Well... you’re a lucky one. $c2_fname just told me you owe him a couple hundred rubles.
Anyway, enough of this soap opera—$mechanic wanted to see you. He also asked me to tell you he won’t keep an eye on your gear. If it gets stolen, that’s on you.
And you haven’t forgotten that $trader is still waiting for the money you borrowed from him, have you?
Anyway, think hard about your little schemes when you get back to camp. Think very carefully!
$leader asked me about you. Guess you've got something serious to do, report back to him when you return.
Even $c2_fname has had enough of your bullshit. $mechanic on the other hand wants you for something important, go check that one out.
And which one of you idiots pissed in my sleeping bag?!
You owe me vodka and a pack of cigarettes. You idiot.
You’re lucky I’m still in a good mood today. And, yeah... $c2_fname stopped by and asked me to tell you that $trader is waiting for you. Hurry over while he’s still in a good mood.
Anyway, screw it. $mechanic is messaging me, telling you to bring the spare parts you promised him the day before yesterday. Do you still have them? Well, that’s your problem.
And when you come back, bring something decent to eat. That’s not a request.
If you don’t want a beating, you’d better find something to treat us with.
Where's my stuff?
You’re pissing me off
You filthy Jew!
I’m sick of you
You’re such a cheapskate
We need to talk
I’ll show you what’s what
You’re in trouble
What’s going on?
I know it was you.
Until next time.
You think that's funny?
What the hell is going on?!
I’ll make you see out of your ass
You asked for it?
How’s your conscience?
A setup
I'm sorry to say that $fname just died.
$fname has gone back to the mud.
We just lost $fname.
$fname $lname didn't make it.
$fname $lname died today.
Ah, $c2_fname... He’s no longer with us...
It’s $c1_fname. I have bad news: $c2_fname is dead...
You’re the first I’m telling: $c2_fname has passed away...
I’ve got sad news, brother... $c2_fname is dead.
We'd just finished hunting and a boar came out of nowhere and gored him.

The guy fell out of a tree... He’d spotted someone’s stash and climbed up after it. But it was pretty high... He slipped on a branch and got impaled on another one—it went right through him, and then he fell down, too...

We lost him on a raid... We went out at night to take down some bloodsuckers on a contract. We thought we’d checked everything—but hell no! His headlamp died right in their hideout, and he was the leader... Then those bastards attacked from every side. Chaos, gunfire... I saw a couple flashes from his position, but then everything went quiet—not even a scream. Once we got that pack of bastards under control and checked the bodies, we found the poor guy... Blood was streaming down his face, and his chest was ripped open.

We were already heading home when some shady stalkers with no insignia ambushed us. We rushed into a house, and then a grenade came through the window. $c2_fname tried to throw it back, but... Damn... He got it outside, but didn’t have time to take cover.
All I know is someone had put a hit out on him... We managed to catch the SOS signal and get there to help, but... Well.
He was walking along the outer ledge of an unfinished building, above “Burning Fluff,” and... slipped. He fell straight onto the damn rebar...

We ran into a pseudogiant in some woods. We managed to climb higher, but our brother didn’t make it before it charged—he went down like he’d been mowed down... We killed the mutant, but $c2_fname... There were bones sticking out of him... And he had internal bleeding, too...
It was the usual route back to camp, we've taken it a thousand times… but he stepped in a Whirligig. It just pulled him straight into the air.
He took a bullet while we were out patrol. Took everyone off guard.
We were taking shelter from an emission and got swarmed by Tushkano. There wasn’t much room to get away from them, and $fname overwhelmed. The little bastards bit straight through his suit.
He was running away from a pack of dogs and they caught him just before we could scare them off.
Not sure what happened but when we found him...well...

It was supposed to be a routine raid... There were no problems until he decided to make a damn campfire at the stop. While we were gathering brush, he went looking for something to eat. All we heard was a sudden, short scream—a damn poltergeist hurled a huge log at him! My gut was right; everything had been going too smoothly...
We didn’t keep an eye on him, and he blundered into a “Springboard” anomaly. It went off and launched him into the air. Every bone in his body was broken.

I knew we shouldn’t have gone into those ruins, damn it! $c2_fname slipped and fell through a hole in the floor; turns out those rats had a nest down there. The bastards had eaten him pretty badly before we could pull him out...
We tried our best, but he bled to death while we were trying to staunch the wound.
We used every bit of medicine we had, but even that didn’t help.
His wounds were too great.
His body just couldn't handle it.
There was just too much trauma, too much blood.
We didn't have enough medical supplies...
We tried to help him as best we could, but there was no chance... Damn!
We were carrying him back to camp, but he suddenly got worse on the way.
We stabilized him as best we could, but on the way to camp he started having terrible convulsions...
There was nothing more we could do for him...
He was just unlucky.
I don’t even know what to tell his brother now.
There was nothing we could do.
I'm so sorry.
He didn’t suffer for long.
He was a good Stalker.
We’ll open a bottle of vodka in memory of him tonight.
He was a good man.
He’s in a better place now.
We’ll remember him when we get back to camp.
I'm so sorry
I’ve got bad news
Another one lost to the Zone
I buried our friend
He was a good Stalker
Another one bites the dust...
Bad news
$fname died
The Zone took $fname
We lost a brother
Just trying to get your attention.
Yeah, sure, ha-ha. But seriously, why have you been so serious lately?
Hey, relax, you’ll burst, sweetheart! Ha-ha.
Just kiddin', don't get mad ok?
Baited!
Hook, line and sinker! Haha!
Ahhhahahahh! I’d love to see your face right now!
You actually believed it? Ha!
Ah, I wish I could see you right now!
Hope your eyes didn’t pop out in surprise. I had no idea how else to shock you, ahem...
Don’t worry, it was just a joke! I was bored, so I decided to mess with you.
Can you bring $c2_fname and me some putinka on your way back?
I need to ask you something, but... Hey, isn’t $leader working you too hard? I’m hungry, and I left my rations at home... Could you grab me something on your way back?
Why am I writing...? $c2_fname found some unknown batteries, and you know your way around those. Could you stop by and take a look?
Actually, I have a reason for contacting you. We found an artifact we’ve never seen before... Could you come take a look? Maybe you know something about it.

But I’m not bothering you for no reason. We caught the bastard who put a bounty on your head. We roughed him up a little, of course, but don’t worry—he’s alive! He’s lying there waiting for you. Heh-heh.
The thing is... About half an hour ago, $leader asked if anyone had the latest anomaly maps. You had some, if I remember right—you made them a couple days ago. Could you give them to him?

But if you think about it, we could make some decent money. $mechanic was looking for a couple rolls of fabric for chemical-protection suits. Remember we stashed something like that about a week ago? What do you think?
By the way... $c2_fname says he forgot to take his PDA out of your backpack this morning after charging it. He says it has important information and all that. You didn’t leave it somewhere, did you?

Did you hear how well $c2_fname did? Even $leader praised his success. I think we should celebrate, too. Looks like $trader got a shipment today. Could you pick up a couple bottles from him on the way?
Everything’s fine around here for now—we don’t have much to do... Hey, how about going hunting?
$c2_fname says he wants a pack of Lucky Strike cigarettes. For me... Marlboro, don't worry I’ll pay you back.
Ok so I’m getting hungry. How about some diet sausages?
$c2_fname came back alive! He met up with us earlier, so we should celebrate tonight! Grab some vodka and food and we can party like it's 1986!
Anyway, can you grab some food? None of this Zone cooked shit though, unless it’s some boar chops.

What I actually wanted to say... My stomach’s been tying itself in knots lately. And $c2_fname isn’t helping—he keeps talking about food, I’m about to hit him! Oh, right... I forgot again! When you’re at the bartender’s or the trader’s, could you bring me something to eat? Even a couple energy bars would do; things are pretty bad...
Anyway, listen! I hear $trader is selling supplies at a discount. I could use a couple packs of glue or oil. Could you borrow some for me? I’ll pay you back, don’t worry.
By the way... On your way back, could you check in on $mechanic? He promised to finally return my gear. He’s gone quiet...

$c2_fname said $trader was getting rid of his surplus, so we bought in bulk—can’t let good stuff fall into the wrong hands, right? We picked up a few things for you, too. When can you come by? Will you make it by eight?
We're almost done with today's shift, so see you in an hour.
I'll be waiting for you. Until then, don't get yourself killed.
Don’t come back empty handed or you’re dead to me. Again.
See you back at camp, Stalker!
Write me when you have a free minute.
I think we’ll be done with our business in two or three hours, and then we can meet up.
When you decide, send me a message.
There’s just one thing: a lot of anomalies have appeared near our main entrance, so be careful.
Oh, one more thing! When you get close to camp, check that grove—there were blind dogs around, I think. I’m not sure.
Someone put a bounty on your head!
The food was poisoned
Infidel, you will die!
That wasn’t lemonade
The vodka was bootleg
GET OUT OF THERE!
My brother died
Bounty hunters!
An obituary
The mechanic lost your gear
You got kicked out
You're being targeted!
Your gun got stolen
I lost a leg
One of our men is dying
I brought a cat to camp
I tamed a pseudodog!
The boss wants to see you
I found a Gauss rifle!
I found a whole exoskeleton!
Our squad turned into zombies
They’re killing us here!
Your friend died recently.
Olives at 50% off
I found an old woman in the Zone!
Bang, good evening!
They’re coming after you!
There’s a hit out on you
A Controller was spotted nearby
A will
The trader put a hit out on you
You lost your backpack
Sup $fname, wanna hear something interesting?
Hello $fname, how are you doing these days?
Hey $fname, this is $c1_fname. I’ve got something for you.
Look who's wearing the daddy pants!
Hey $fname, this is $c1_fname. I’ve got something for you.
Well hello there $fname.
I am the greatest friend you've never had.
I got my hands on some old documents from $trader. They have details about a few locations around the Zone. Sounds like a bunch of researchers wrote this.
I met $c2_lname today and he knows about the situation. He showed me an easy passage to move safely between some areas around the Zone.
So I bought some info from $trader. The bastard wanted a lot of money for this.
I got some help from an old friend the other day. He used to be a guide in the early days but he’s taking things easy now.
One of the veterans showed me his map this morning. I managed to take some notes.
I found a Stalker who’d been caught in a blowout earlier. He tried to take shelter but it wasn’t enough. Anyway, while I was inspecting his PDA I found some useful information.
I was looting a body just now and I found a PDA with a few incredibly interesting entries.
For helping with his request, $trader gave me some papers from a cartographer. I looked through them and found something interesting.
I had to help him with something to get $trader to share the information, but it was worth it.
Take a look at these routes between $map_route_1 and $map_route_2. Maybe one day you’ll need to use this.
Remember when we spent the night talking about how to get to $map_route_1 from $map_route_2? This will show you some good routes. You’re welcome!
I found a safer path after we tried that route the other day.
Here’s a path between $map_route_1 and $map_route_2. It used to be blocked by anomalies but it should be clear now.
Anyway, I’ve learned the detour: “$map_route_1 - $map_route_2.” It’s exactly what we were looking for.
All right, I’ll get straight to the point: we now know the route “$map_route_2 - $map_route_1.”
Here’s the new detour, “$map_route_2 - $map_route_1.” Everything’s marked on the map.
Remember how you kept saying this wouldn’t work without a proper route? What about “$map_route_1 - $map_route_2”?
I just hope you won’t tell anyone about this. Anyway, here’s another route: “$map_route_2 - $map_route_1.”
Now I can't really promise that this is the safest way possible, but this is all I've got for now. I might ask around to see if someone can provide me with better sources.
All good? Let me know if you need something else. See you around.
If you plan to visit the place someday, let me know. Take care of yourself.
Be careful if you make the journey without me. You still owe me a drink from last time.
Good luck out there! Let me know if you find any new routes yourself.
This might be useful...
Fresh intel
Looks like a good passage.
Take a look at this route.
Found a new route

Hello $c1_fname. I'm in $map right now, $directional $pointer.
This is $c1_fname. The squad is currently $directional $pointer. We’ve already gathered some preliminary data, and we also have information from our observations.
$c1_fname, this is $fname. The research team has made it to $map, $directional $pointer.
Ok $c1_fname, I arrived at $map 15 minutes ago. According to the detector, the anomalous activity $directional $pointer is powerful.
This is $c1_fname $c1_lname. My group has reached the assigned coordinates: $map, $directional $pointer.
Relaying coordinates: $map, $directional $pointer. The group has already begun collecting data.
$leader, this is $c1_fname $c1_lname, commander of the research squad. We’ve reached the site and set up a field camp. We’re currently $directional $pointer.
$leader, this is $c1_fname. I’ve arrived with the research squad at point $directional $pointer. We have our first results.
The research squad is on site. Relaying the first details from our observations.
This is $c1_fname $c1_lname, head of the research squad. Our coordinates are: $map, $directional $pointer. We arrived about an hour ago and already have preliminary data.
As expected, the last emission made an impact on the anomalous fields in the area. My dosimeter is ticking quite a lot too, the radiation level is high here.

We directly witnessed five zombified stalkers walk straight into the field’s epicenter. None of them survived, that’s certain. Unfortunately, it was also impossible to attempt to collect samples of their tissue and brains.
The area seems different. There are three new Vortex anomalies next to each other. The last psi-storm was indeed rough.
The anomalies have shifted and the readings have worsened.
Mutants seem to be avoiding this area, even though we’re out in the open and vulnerable. It’s very interesting behaviour...
Radiation levels have doubled compared with the last data collection. Anomalous activity has also changed—we were lucky to collect a couple of samples of anomalous formations.

The overall anomaly field is extremely unstable: instruments show that the southern part of the field is losing activity, while the northern part is retaining it. We even obtained one sample of an anomalous formation, 1 unit.
Although the instruments aren’t fully calibrated yet, we can say for certain that the artifacts did not form as a result of the emission.
Although anomalous activity is below average, we were lucky to find two samples, which were immediately isolated in SIMKs.

I’d like to note that the feline creatures acted extremely aggressively, as if guarding this territory. Unfortunately, there were no zoologists in the squad, so we had to eliminate the obstacle to continue our work.

I'm standing near one of the Vortexes here, and this one is abnormal compared to what we've seen before. The gravitational field is very strong, but the weirdest part is that it's not stationary! It shows some random movement, and the radius is expanding with time. But it seems that the gravitational field loses some of its power because of this behaviour.
Now the interesting part is this Whirligig. The gravity field is very strong near this one.
But what caught my eye the most is this Springboard anomaly. Unlike others, the radius is around 5 metres. It's massive!
Still, as for the primary objective, $mechanic was absolutely right about his theory. Amazing!

The new anomalies along the field’s outer perimeter, which have a different origin, should definitely be taken into account. There seem to be conditions that prevent them from forming inside a larger anomalous field.
At the moment, $c2_fname $c2_lname is trying to find the best spot inside the field to collect a couple soil samples.
While I collect data on anomalous activity from the outside, $c2_fname $c2_lname is trying to find a way into the very heart of the anomaly field.
Do you want me to take measurements of it?
Oh no... The data-collection equipment has attracted the attention of nearby mutants again. We need to prepare. $c1_fname $c1_lname, over and out.

Considering the analyses, data collection, and preparation of several samples for transport back to camp, we should finish in about three hours. If nothing new comes up, we’ll check in before leaving.
How about I plant a few sensors around the field so you can see the readings yourself?
I’ll try and gather more readings and make more observations. I'll send the data over when I’m done.
I think we’ll set up camp nearby so we can take readings at different times of day. Though we probably won’t get more precise results.
We’ll set up the equipment needed for readings, then retreat to the nearest shelter until the next emission. We plan to check in both before it begins and after it ends.
As soon as we finish collecting all the necessary data, we’ll be ready to move on to the next coordinates.
User $c1_fname $c1_lname disconnected.

The “Electras” just detected in the immediate vicinity of the field are affecting the equipment’s performance and accuracy. We won’t take any risks: we’ll collect the critical data and return to the MBU.

I can’t say for certain how the local wildlife will react to a more invasive measurement method, so we could use an additional security squad. Please contact the nearest squad of colleagues or stalkers and send them our way, all right?
Made it to the anomaly field

Shit, I found a Moonlight in $map. I'm so fucking lucky.
What luck! I found my very own “Wrenched” in some shabby stash. The owner’s to blame for leaving such a gift unattended.

What a find! The “Goldfish” itself, can you believe it?! Every scavenger’s wet dream! And it happened in such a ridiculous way... I was hiding from boars in a gravity-anomaly field, ha-ha. When their guts poured over me like from a bucket, I thought I’d kicked a bone or a rock, but nope... Just in case, I shook my half-dead detector—and it picked up an artifact!

Whew, I almost got cooked in the “Frying Pans”! Imagine this: just as I was about to grab the “Fireball,” the ground crumbled beneath me and I went down with it, straight to hell. I don’t know how I did it—must’ve been the adrenaline—but I shot back up on all fours like lightning. It took a few minutes to recover, and I poured my last water over myself, but at least I kept the artifact.

I almost got blown to pieces by a “Flash” anomaly while running from a swarm of blind tushkanos. First they ran into a “Fluff,” then they set off an “Electra.” Honestly, I didn’t have to think long before jumping the fence and climbing onto the pipes. Guess what I found there? A “Flash”—one hell of an artifact!

I somehow ended up in Yantar at night. I’ll tell you, it felt pretty unsettling, but what can you do? I decided to go around “Poisoned Lake” when I heard rustling in the reeds. I raised my gun, but there was nobody there! I stood still for a few minutes. Then I remembered there’d been an emission recently. I pulled out my detector, and bam—a “Meat Chunk” appeared right in front of me.

Remember that eerie place in Dark Valley, where the ground was cracked and it was all boiling inside? “Dark Rift,” I think it was called, right? Anyway, when things were quiet, I decided to check that anomaly field. And what do you think I found? A whole “Crystal.”
I have no idea how I ended up in the Red Forest, but while trying to get out as quickly as possible, I was lucky enough to find a “Snowflake.”

A couple hours ago I was crossing a gravity-anomaly field when I suddenly found an artifact. A “Jellyfish” isn’t much, but you don’t look a gift pseudodog in the mouth. Besides, it wasn’t hard to find.

$leader recommended I visit a certain place as a reward for my services. He said the find wouldn’t disappoint. He was right! I got lucky and found a “Mama’s Beads” artifact in a stash, though I had to hop around between some nasty anomalies.

I was hanging around the “Barrier” at noon when cats suddenly sprang out of nowhere. I ran from them as fast as I could until I wound up among gravity anomalies. The cats were scattered in pieces all over the place, but I got lucky and found a “Night Star.” I don’t know if it was already there or if those things tipped me off, but I pocketed the artifact right away.
Woo! I just found a Bubble!

This is $c1_fname $c1_lname. Remember that old fishing rod we saw in one of the sheds? I found a use for it, heh. Bet you can’t guess what: fishing artifacts out of gravity anomalies! The simplest ideas are genius! That’s how I got a “Goldfish,” ha-ha. The rod’s done for, though... But making a new one is easy.

Damn, I almost ran into an anomaly while escaping the mutants. I glanced back for a second, tripped over a root, and went tumbling toward something sparkling. I didn’t realize right away they were “Electras”—who can see anything in that fog? I got badly spooked, but stopped right at the edge of the field. It was somewhere in the Red Forest... But on the other side of that same anomaly, I found a “Shell.” Now that’s worth heading out for! Like they say, what doesn’t kill you makes you richer.

Want to hear a story? I wandered through electric anomalies and found nothing. I barely made it to the Brain Scorcher at Army Warehouses. There was an abandoned hamlet farther south... It looked empty, so I decided to check the “Electras” just in case. Imagine this: I found an “Electron”! The devil tempted me to haul it back, but I tripped on one of the boulders and fell... I counted every bone! That artifact annoyed me so much I threw the damn thing away—I wasn’t dragging six kilos of junk to my grave! Before I reached the hamlet, an emission hit. I sheltered in a hut and decided to check one last time... And guess what? You won’t believe it! A “Shell”! A whole damn “Shell”!

Some seasoned stalkers took me all the way to Jupiter—I’d never been there! They showed me around and told me lots of interesting things. There was a place there that looked like a grove, I think it was called the “Anomalous Grove.” The guys found several artifacts and apparently decided not to leave me out. Luckily, I had a SIMK with me just in case. Though who knows what they could even see in that acid fog... Anyway, they gave me a “Soul” artifact too—they already had plenty, they said, no need to be greedy. The name fits the company perfectly, doesn’t it?

Hey, it’s $c1_fname! I’m sitting here in camp, keeping myself busy... I just remembered I found a “Stone Flower” after one of the recent emissions. Maybe it’s not much, but you get what the Zone gives you! And with barely any effort—I only had to hop between anomalies like a schoolgirl playing hopscotch, heh.

I found a “Fireball” completely by accident, without even having to look for a fireproof suit or coolant! I taped the detector to a long steel pole and quickly swept it between the “Frying Pans”—the artifact rolled right into my hands.
$mechanic wasn’t lying—his boots held up well against that acid! I weaved through the “Gasers” like a minefield, but still managed to pull out a “Bracelet”!
You won’t believe it—I pulled a “Flame” out of the anomaly. The fireproof suit really helped! $mechanic will be glad to hear it; he worked hard on that suit.
